title: 第13章 顿悟第14章 暗流涌动
slug: 吞天混沌经开局先吞圣女修为
content_zh:
第13章顿悟
半月时间，弹指已过，
卧房中，随着《吞天混沌经》的运转，气海中的真元如同潮水一般，他经脉中金色符文闪耀，仿佛化为金色天神，
真元如潮，发出破浪之音，神秘而又玄奥，
他参悟着吞天混沌经的各种要义，圣人传承化为山河画卷在他脑海中流淌，更与之前所修仙法相互印证，掌间法诀凝聚，曾经一次次巅峰对决在脑中浮现，他从当中曾受过无尽启发，获取过无上仙位。
良久，他缓缓睁开双眸，眼中神光璀璨，却面带一抹忧思，
这些天江尘每日都在修炼《吞天混沌经》，琢磨凝气之法，进展却十分缓慢，圣人之法太过玄奥，即便是以他的见识也难以参透全部，
想要睡觉，却是体内燥热不断，总是想起那晚的旖旎场景，翻来覆去的睡不着，
其实这也不能怪江尘，南宫婉儿本就是魅魔血脉，
对异性魅力极大，
别说她身姿妖娆，举止风流，只是不经意散发的魅惑气息就不是寻常男人能抵挡的，
江尘盘膝而坐，真元在气海涌动，不断冲刷着经脉，足足半个时辰，虽然感觉通体舒泰，但心中还是有一股抹不去的燥热，
思虑片刻，便直接去了院中，脱下上衣，从水井中提起水桶，浇在头顶，连连几桶，燥热却是仍旧不退，
江尘提起精钢长枪，
便按照江烈遗留的武技演练起来，虽只是一阶武技，但在江尘手中，发挥的威力不次于二阶，
重重刺击，无终无极，枪法亦是如此，动作开阔大气，大开大合，如江海波涛，无穷无尽，
虽然还没有踏足凝气境界，但体内真元运转，依旧气势磅礴，
江家宅子本就不大，南宫婉儿自是被院中的动静惊醒，
披上薄衫，踱步来到廊边，便看到江尘枪法行云流水，虽然招式简陋，但隐含大道至理，南宫婉儿抿着红唇，美眸泛起异彩，
江尘浑身都是汗水，攻守之间，酣畅淋漓，

突然，她呆滞了，
只见江尘经脉中隐隐出现一道道金色符文，这是只有修行九劫魔功之人才能看到的至高战纹，
九劫魔宗是由一位旷古烁今的绝代天魔所创，他曾获取无上机缘，得到天书残卷半篇，晦涩玄奥，他天才绝艳，却只参透寥寥数行，便一跃成为了魔族至强者，更是借此残篇，创造了魔族十大功法之一的九劫魔功。
传说九劫魔功修行至大成，身上便有至高战纹显现，威能无穷无尽，江尘经脉中的金色符文虽只是一闪而逝，但身为九劫魔宗圣女的她却看得清清楚楚，
她呼吸有些急促，难怪她会对江尘有着天然的亲近，九劫魔功已经数万年没有修至大成的记录，这个人族男子，究竟是如何做到的！
虽然他此时仍旧十分弱小，但是一个拥有至高战纹的人族，绝非寻常之辈！
江尘发现了廊边的南宫婉儿，
“这么晚了，怎么还不睡？”
南宫婉儿不动声色，
“你大半夜在这里练枪，吵得很，我怎么睡得着？”
南宫婉儿依着廊柱，此时只身披一件薄衫，玲珑有致的身姿诱人无比，
“这门枪法你练了多久？”
“三五天吧，怎么样，被我的枪法折服了吧。”
“切，就这点本事，还想让我折服。”
江尘一本正经，
“你要说其他的不行我认，你要说我枪法不行，这可是男人的耻辱。”
南宫婉儿顿时知道江尘说的是什么，心中一阵羞恼，随即美眸一转，
“二十岁连凝气期都达不到，枪法好有什么用。
这下轮到江尘憋屈了，气海早已充盈，为何不能凝气入脉，
南宫婉儿心中突然生出一个疯狂的想法，

Chapter 13 Epiphany
Half a month has passed in a snap,
In the bedroom, as the "Swallowing Heaven Chaos Sutra" circulates, the true energy in the sea of ​​qi is like a tide, and the golden runes in his meridians shine, as if he has turned into a golden god.
The true essence is like a tide, making a sound of breaking waves, mysterious and mysterious,
He comprehended the various essences of the Heaven-Swallowing Chaos Sutra, and the saint's inheritance turned into a picture of mountains and rivers flowing in his mind. It was also mutually confirmed with the immortal methods he had practiced before.
After a long time, he slowly opened his eyes, his eyes were bright, but there was a hint of worry on his face.
Jiang Chen has been practicing the "Swallowing Heaven Chaos Sutra" every day these days, pondering the method of condensing Qi, but the progress is very slow. The method of the saint is too mysterious, even with his knowledge, it is difficult to understand everything.
I want to sleep, but my body is constantly hot and hot. I always think of the beautiful scene that night, and I toss and turn, unable to fall asleep.
In fact, this cannot be blamed on Jiang Chen, Nangong Wan'er is of succubus blood.
Very attractive to the opposite sex,
Not to mention her enchanting figure and elegant demeanor, the charming aura she exudes inadvertently is not something ordinary men can resist.
Jiang Chen sat cross-legged, his true energy surging in the sea of ​​qi, constantly flushing his meridians. For half an hour, although he felt comfortable all over his body, there was still a heat in his heart that could not be wiped away.
After thinking for a moment, he went directly to the courtyard, took off his shirt, picked up a bucket from the well, and poured it on his head, several buckets in a row, but the heat did not subside.
Jiang Chen picked up the fine steel spear,
Then he practiced according to the martial arts skills left by Jiang Lie. Although they were only first-level martial arts, in Jiang Chen's hands, the power exerted was no less than that of the second-level martial arts.
Heavy thrusts are endless, and the same is true for marksmanship. The movements are broad and majestic, opening and closing like the waves of a river and sea, endless.
Although he has not yet set foot in the realm of Qi Condensation, the movement of true energy within his body is still majestic.
The Jiang family house is not big, so Nangong Wan'er was naturally awakened by the movement in the courtyard.
Putting on a thin shirt, she walked to the corridor and saw Jiang Chen's marksmanship. Although the moves were simple, they contained great principles. Nangong Wan'er pursed her red lips and her beautiful eyes glowed.
Jiang Chen's whole body was covered in sweat, and he was dripping with sweat between offense and defense.
Suddenly, she froze,
I saw golden runes faintly appearing in Jiang Chen's meridians. This is the supreme battle pattern that can only be seen by those who practice the Nine Tribulations Demonic Art.
The Nine Tribulations Demon Sect was created by a peerless heavenly demon from ancient times to the present. He once had the unparalleled opportunity to obtain half of a fragment of the Book of Heaven, which was obscure and mysterious. He was extremely talented, but only understood a few lines, and he became the strongest of the demon clan. He also used this fragment to create the Nine Tribulations Demon Technique, one of the ten major techniques of the demon clan.
Legend has it that when the Nine Tribulations Demonic Skills are cultivated to perfection, supreme war marks will appear on the body, with endless power. Although the golden runes in Jiang Chen's meridians only flashed away, as a saint of the Nine Tribulations Demon Sect, she could see them clearly.
Her breathing was a little rapid. No wonder she was naturally close to Jiang Chen. There was no record of the Nine Tribulations Demonic Art being perfected for tens of thousands of years. How did this human race man do it?
Although he is still very weak at this time, a human race with the supreme war mark is by no means an ordinary person!
Jiang Chen spotted Nangong Wan'er on the corridor.
"It's so late, why aren't you sleeping?"
Nangong Wan'er remained calm,
"You're practicing shooting here in the middle of the night. It's so noisy. How can I sleep?"
Nangong Wan'er was leaning on the corridor pillar, wearing only a thin shirt at this time, her exquisite and graceful figure was extremely alluring.
"How long have you been practicing this marksmanship?"
"Three to five days. How about it? You are impressed by my marksmanship."
"Tch, you still want to impress me with this little ability."
Jiang Chen was serious,
"If you say I'm not good at other things, I admit it. If you say I'm not good at shooting, this is a man's shame."
Nangong Wan'er immediately knew what Jiang Chen saidWhat is it? I felt ashamed and annoyed, and then I turned my beautiful eyes,
"You can't even reach the Qi Condensation stage at the age of twenty, so what's the use of being good at shooting.
Now it was Jiang Chen's turn to feel aggrieved. The sea of Qi was already full, so why couldn't he condense the Qi into his meridians?
Nangong Wan'er suddenly had a crazy idea in her heart,
